props.covers: Event protocol design: TraceEvent envelope, core event types, trace levels, sources, deterministic event ids, kernel-authored message markers, and app extension behavior.

props.description: The envelope every trace event carries. eventData holds the type-specific payload.

fields.name: eventId
fields.description: Primary key of the trace_events row. Pi-derived events get a deterministic id; other factory events get a random UUID.

fields.name: containerId
fields.description: The single required grouping identity. There is no app-session field.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Open string union. Unknown types still store, stream, and render as generic rows.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Names the emitter; open to other strings. The in-process emitter and the backfill mapper re-stamp Pi-derived events as agent.

fields.name: traceLevel
fields.description: Viewer filtering hint, set by the factory.

fields.name: eventData
fields.description: Payload whose shape the type selects.

fields.name: runId
fields.description: Stamped at emit time when the run is known. Run lifecycle factories require it.

fields.name: spanId
fields.description: Tool events use the tool call id, pairing start and end.

fields.name: piSessionUuid
fields.description: Transport-only. The Pi session UUID from JSONL line 1. The write path stores it in trace_events.pi_session_id; no column keeps this name.
